messages:
sara: Heads up — pushed a config-only change to routing weights (infra/routing/configs/weights.json). Deploy window tonight. Do we bump the patch?

tim: If it's purely config with no API/behavioral surface change for clients we usually skip semver. Did it touch manifests that trigger auto-bump?

sara: No manifests, just the JSON weight table. PR label defaulted to `chore`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: detected files: infra/routing/configs/weights.json. Suggested label: chore. Auto-bump: enabled for infra changes. To override, add `skip-release-bump: true` to PR body.

jess: I'm leaning skip. Weight tweaks are ops-only, but they can change traffic distribution and surface perf regressions. Add a short note in release notes and monitor canary.

omar: Also double-check model variant pinning — if the routing change points to a different variant tag, that *is* a consumer-affecting change.

sara: Confirmed: same variant names, only weight percentages changed (70/30 -> 60/40). Canary run on staging shows no latency delta. Logs: `p90 latency diff +3ms`.

tim: OK. Practical approach: no semver bump, but require an explicit release-note line: `infra: adjust model routing weights (canary) — no API change`. If deploy-bot auto-bumps, use the PR override.

jess: Agreed. Also add a simple rollback plan in the PR description: how to revert weights and who to ping.

sara: Added `skip-release-bump: true` and rollback steps. PR body now has a tiny code block with the revert command:

```
# revert weights to previous file
git checkout origin/main -- infra/routing/configs/weights.json
kubectl apply -f infra/routing/configs/weights.json
```

deploy-bot: override acknowledged. No semver bump will be scheduled. Canary rollout at 22:00 PT; will post status. :rocket:

release-czar: Please add the single-line release note to the release-draft board so docs can pick it up: `Adjust routing weights for model variant experiment — no API changes`. Mark as `no-bump` in the notes.

sara: done. I'll watch canary and escalate if p95 increases >10%.

jess: thanks — sounds good. If anything looks off, we'll pin traffic back to 70/30 and cut an emergency patch.

tim: minor process note: maybe we should add a checklist rule to infra changes that affect routing percentages — force a human review even if labeled chore. Filing a tiny follow-up RFC.

sara: SG. Filing RFC after this.

release-czar: noted. :white_check_mark:
